Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
PRESS WORKING DIE SETS ( BOSS TYPE ) 

PART III CENTRE POST ROUND DIE SETS 



i j 1. Scope — Covers dimensions and other requirements for boss type round die sets with two guide 
1 posts in central axis. 

2. Principal Dimensions — See Table 1. 

3. Designation 

3.1 A centre post round die set Type A of cast iron having a die space d t = 60 mm with guide posts 
Type A with round end and length = 160 mm and without any guide bushes fttted-m snail be 
designated as: 

Die Set AC-80 IS : 9266 ( Part 111 ) along with Guide Posts AR-19/20 x 160 IS ; 7664 

3.2 Die set as above but with guide bushes Type C shall be designated as: 

Die Set AC-80 IS : 9266 ( Part IN ) along with Guide Posts AR-19/20 X 160 IS : 7664 and 
Guide Bushes C 19/20 IS : 81 27 

3.3 A centre post round die set of cast steel having a die space tfi = 60 mm with guide posts Type B 
with tapered end and length = 160 mm and with guide bushes Type A of length / ~ 50 mm shall be 
designated as: 

Die Set AS-80 IS ■ 9266 ( Part III ) along with Guide Posts 8T- 19/20 x 160 IS : 7664 and Guide 
Bushes A-19/20 x 50 IS , 8127 

4. Material — The top and bottom tool holders shall be of cast iron of grade FG 260 of IS : 210-1978 
'Specification for grey iron castings { third revision ) ' or cast steel of grade 23-45 of IS ; 1030-1974 
'Carbon steel castings for general engineering purposes ( second revision ) '. 

5. General Requirements — The top and bottom tool holders shall be tree from cracks, burrs and 
pits and shall satisfy for accuracy when tested in accordance with the draft Indian Standard 
Test chart for press working die sets ( under preparation ). 

Note— TiN such time the *tandard under preparation is published, tUo matter shall be as agreed upon between 
the concerned parties. 

6. Marking 

6.1 The designation and the manufacturer's trade-mark to appear at a prominent place on tool 

holders. 

6.2 Certification Mar Ming — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards,
